action.mutates: creates /opt/puppetlabs/server/data/puppetserver/reports/p8test-node and its missing parents (from /opt/puppetlabs/server on an agent node), with old.yaml dated 10 days ago and recent.yaml dated 2 days ago (the store the master's puppetserver keeps)
runs the cron entry's command once as root (sh -c, as cron does), which deletes the planted 10-day-old report

outcomes.outcome: root's crontab runs the cleanup at midnight every day, on the Hiera report directory and age
the command deletes report files older than 7 days and keeps newer ones

uncovered.why: a run would have to wait for midnight; the crontab entry is checked and the command it holds is run by hand
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: a clock-controlled cron trigger inside a phase3 run
uncovered.evidence: phase3.py runs probes and agent runs only; it has no step that advances or waits for the node's cron schedule
